title: Highly Recommend!
text: This was such a wonderful way to enjoy a few hours on a very hot day. Bruno was a great skipper. First time for several of us in our group of 5 to sail. Such a beautiful way to enjoy the water.
author: Shelli_R

title: Lovely evening in Barselona
text: It was a sunset cruise with only 2 other people. Besides serving as our boat captain, he also served us drinks and a nice little snack spread of meats, cheese and fruit. It was perfect.
author: Roseanna_B

title: Great
text: Everything correct, quite pleasant, excellent crew.
author: enriquelB5719WP
